We provide sovereign commerce infrastructure that removes geographic barriers. No platforms. No subscriptions. No middlemen. You own the stack. You control the flow. This guide walks you through deploying your own ebook store from Ghana—using Cloudflare, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-2|The Complete]]-infrastructure-5|supabase]], and blockchain payments. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they are centralized. They rely on banking systems, compliance frameworks, and geographic restrictions. When Stripe blocks Ghana, it’s not a bug—it’s their business model. COREMERCH’s infrastructure is decentralized. It uses Cloudflare for hosting, Supabase for order storage, and blockchain for payments. No single point of failure. No geographic restrictions. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—free, global, and immutable. Payments are processed on-chain via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts. The moment payment confirms, the ebook delivers automatically. This architecture is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure designed for regions where conventional platforms fail. You’re not renting a solution—you’re owning it.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your assets. Your ebook in PDF or EPUB format. A domain name (optional but recommended for professionalism). A Cloudflare account (free) for hosting and DNS. A NOWPayments account (free) for crypto payment processing. Basic understanding of GitHub or Cloudflare Pages for deployment. If you choose the Edge Commerce Stack, you’ll also need a Supabase account (free tier available) for order storage. No coding required—COREMERCH provides templates and blueprints. But familiarity with web basics helps. You’ll configure DNS records, upload files, and connect APIs. The Complete Builder Kit includes all templates and step-by-step guides. Purchase it once, deploy unlimited stores. This is not a subscription. It’s a toolkit for infrastructure sovereignty.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payments. Log in to NOWPayments, create a payment link for your ebook, and select your preferred cryptocurrency (BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees). Set up a webhook to trigger delivery. Next, host your ebook. Upload it to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Generate a shareable link with expiration settings. For backend logic, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. COREMERCH’s templates include pre-built scripts that verify payment via the webhook and send the download link to the buyer. Test the flow manually before deploying. Ensure the payment triggers the delivery. Once confirmed, deploy the stack to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Your store is now live, accepting payments, and delivering ebooks—automatically, 24/7, without your intervention.
Own your infrastructure. No platforms. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store by pushing the code to GitHub or Cloudflare. Configure your custom domain (if using one) and point it to your hosting platform. Test the entire flow: place an order, send a test payment, and ensure the ebook delivers. Monitor the Supabase or Google Sheets database to confirm the order is logged. Once live, share your store link with your audience. Promote it on social media, email lists, or your website. When the first payment comes in, the webhook fires, the ebook delivers, and the order is recorded. You’ve just processed a transaction without Stripe, PayPal, or any middleman. Your infrastructure is now operational—and entirely under your control.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the base infrastructure deployed, scaling is straightforward. Add more products by duplicating the payment and delivery pipeline. Use Supabase to manage inventory and orders at scale. Optimize your store for SEO by adding metadata and content to your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site. Integrate email marketing by connecting your Supabase database to tools like Mailgun or SendGrid. Monitor performance using Cloudflare Analytics or Google Sheets. As your audience grows, upgrade your Supabase plan or switch to a paid tier of Cloudflare R2 for storage. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook with advanced strategies. This is not a temporary solution—it’s a permanent infrastructure designed to grow with your business.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather your ebook files and create a Cloudflare account.
2. Sign up for NOWPayments and configure a payment link.
3. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
4. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
5. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
6. Test the payment and delivery flow end-to-end.
7. Configure your custom domain (optional).
8. Promote your store and process your first transaction.
9. Monitor orders in Supabase or Google Sheets.
10. Scale by adding more products and optimizing for growth.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?
Yes. COREMERCH provides pre-built templates and step-by-step guides. No coding required. Familiarity with web basics helps, but the Complete Builder Kit is designed for non-developers.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use to pay?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. We recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need to pay monthly fees for this infrastructure?
No. The hosting, backend, and storage tools are free tiers. NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. No subscriptions. No hidden costs.
Can I sell other digital products besides ebooks?
Yes. The infrastructure works for courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and any digital product. Simply duplicate the payment and delivery pipeline.
What happens if a payment fails or the buyer disputes it?
Blockchain payments are irreversible. Once confirmed, the transaction cannot be disputed. Use test payments during setup to ensure the flow works flawlessly.
